arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا.
transliteration: Allahumma baarik lanaa fee thamarinaa, wa baarik lanaa fee madeenatinaa, wa baarik lanaa fee saa'inaa, wa baarik lanaa fee muddinaa.
translation: O Allah, bless us in our fruits, and bless us in our city, and bless us in our Sa' (a measure), and bless us in our Mudd (a measure).
